$schemaNote: buildCommand: production runs Postgres (Neon) — the postgres schema twin is swapped in at build time and the prisma client regenerated against it. Dev/tests keep SQLite via prisma/schema.prisma (the swap happens only in Vercel's fresh build container and is never committed).
buildCommand: cp prisma/schema.postgres.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate && next build
